grid10_thread_latency.result: With four concurrent model processes on the measured 4-vCPU surface, one torch intra-op thread per process averaged 8.3197 s/call over 12 samples; two threads averaged 23.1806 s/call over 12 samples; four threads produced zero completed samples within the experiment timeouts.
grid10_thread_latency.interpretation: The external recommendation that two threads/process should be faster was directly falsified. The existing default of one thread/process is supported for this measured 4-process/4-vCPU workload. This is consistent with PyTorch's official multiprocessing guidance to avoid CPU oversubscription and use at most floor(vCPUs/processes) threads per process.
